_comment: Committed (said, heard) ASR pairs for keyless entity-fidelity. No Piper, no network, no EL minutes. The V1 Czech call transcribed Reactem as Rustem and PostgreSQL as později SQL: aggregate WER stayed inside budget while two spoken skills were lost. voice_checks gates that class via entity_fidelity; this file is the corpus that test:python:gate can run without a live agent.
